messages:
marie_cs: Heads-up — Lumosys production embedding volume dropped ~78% since Thu morning. Daily embeddings: 88k -> 19k. VP of ML (internal champion) left last week; new director asked procurement to evaluate MercuryAI. Renewal ~ 5w out. Need triage.

jason_am: renewal date? ARR?

marie_cs: 2026-04-30 renewal, ARR $120k, two reserved pools.

anya_csm: any account signals besides token delta? login/seat metrics, API keys disabled?

devon_se: checking runtime logs. Quick check: their nightly batch job shows repeated OOMs starting 2026-03-12. Retries dropped off overnight. Could be customer-side container size change or our batching heuristic.

olga_prod: if procurement is talking to MercuryAI they'll ask model parity & latency numbers. Can we prepare a short one-pager: accuracy comparison on their sample, latency/cost delta, and migration checklist?

marie_cs: yes — i'll ask Lumosys for a sample embedding set and the list of model ids they were using.

anya_csm: i'll DM the new director to set 30m discovery. Goal: confirm priority (cost vs quality) and whether Mercury pilot is embeddings-only.

jason_am: recommend not offering deep discounts yet. propose a 2-week remediation + priority support package if issue is on our side. If problem is their job, show rollback/runbook and offer limited credits.

devon_se: action for me: 1) verify batch config history, 2) check prefix/KV cache metrics and batching window changes, 3) produce 1-slide root cause + mitigation steps.

ops-bot: Calendar invite created: #lumosys-triage 2026-03-20 15:00 — marie_cs, devon_se, anya_csm, jason_am, olga_prod

marie_cs: draft outreach: "we noticed your nightly embeddings job started failing last week and volumes dropped. can you confirm the cron, container size, and whether you changed the batch size? happy to jump into a runbook session." edits?

anya_csm: add request for a small sample dataset and any logs from their batch runner. ask whether MercuryAI contacted them already.

devon_se: uploading preliminary charts to triage doc. If it's our regression we'll flag a hotfix path; if customer-side, include exact config diffs and test commands to restore.

jason_am: i'll draft procurement talking points comparing reserved-cost math vs Mercury pilot cost for 3-months. Keep options: quick technical review + conditional credit.

olga_prod: i'll prepare product-side bullets: supported model variants, known edge-cases for embedding cosine drift, and recommended quantization settings.

marie_cs: thanks. reconvene after discovery call and decide offer cadence. I'll track tasks in the doc.
